niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that are visually calm, clearly structured, and generally lighter in tone, with spacious layouts, soft rounded components, explicit hierarchy, and prominent clearly labeled primary actions. They repeatedly favor reduced clutter, fewer competing elements, subtle rather than heavy surfaces, and organized card/list structures with readable labels and status cues. Although there is one isolated preference for a dark premium pricing screen and one for a darker minimal dashboard, the dominant pattern is toward light neutral backgrounds with soft purple/gray accents, open spacing, and simplified presentation.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral or light gray backgrounds with soft purple/gray accents and lower overall contrast, rather than predominantly dark high-contrast interfaces with saturated blue/green accents.
Prefers more spacious, simplified layouts with generous whitespace, calmer vertical rhythm, and fewer stacked or competing elements.
Prefers strong structure and readability: clear section titles, explicit labels, aligned rows, helper text, and content organized so hierarchy is immediately understandable.
Prefers organized card-based sections or flat structured rows with clearly defined interaction areas, instead of oversized decorative elements, ambiguous components, or overly heavy per-item cards.
Prefers a single obvious, high-contrast primary CTA that looks active and important, often full-width or clearly emphasized, with strong separation from secondary actions.
Prefers softer rounded cards/controls, subtle borders, minimal shadows, and lighter visual weight rather than sharp, rigid, heavily shadowed, or visually heavy surfaces.
Prefers minimal presentation with reduced decorative noise, fewer icons or extra UI layers, and content shown directly and simply rather than through busy overlays or embellishment.
